headline: Exchanges Took In 1,144.2 Million Dollars As Binance Took In 761.5 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 1,144.2 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.4195 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, up from 116.2 million dollars and 0.0427 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means that money arrived where holders can sell. Binance took in 761.5 million dollars, OKX took in 167.6 million, Gate took in 121.1 million, and Bybit took in 92.1 million.
author: jordan
